bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Threat is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make Resolve tests to continue fighting.

bonuses.name: Hatches & Tunnels
bonuses.text: Within the Orrery complex, the Attendant has numerous secret tunnels for moving around. It gains +5 Dice to Stealth checks to Surprise intruders.

bonuses.name: Guardian
bonuses.text: The Attendant is tied to the noosphere of the Orrery complex, and receives +2 Dice to Awareness (Int) Tests and +4 Dice to Tech (Int) Tests to repair the Orrery while within its walls.

abilities.name: Hidden Defences
abilities.text: Within the Orrery complex, the Attendant can activate a variety of hidden defences. On the first round of combat it activates a hidden gun platform (effectively an immobile Combat Servitor, Wrath & Glory Rulebook, page 334).

abilities.name: Repair Protocol Gamma 19
abilities.text: Should the Attendant be destroyed while Orrery still functions, automated systems will attempt to trap a Human subject and create a new Attendant from spare parts. This takes 1d6 hours.
